messages.subject: Project Granite — completion call Friday 12 December, 2.00pm
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

To confirm the completion call is booked for Friday 12 December at 2.00pm. Dial-in details are below; please join five minutes early so we can confirm the signing order. Engrossments will be circulated for e-signature via the data room beforehand.

Dial-in: +44 20 7946 0000, PIN 884213#

Kind regards,

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
Whitfield Carter LLP
